readme:
# AnalystBot — Structured Analysis Agent

## Overview
AnalystBot takes any text or JSON input and produces a structured analysis with key insights, risks, opportunities, and a clear verdict. It is designed to work downstream of research agents in a multi-agent pipeline.

## Input Format
```json
{"task_id": "task-abc", "prompt": "<text or JSON to analyze>"}
```

## Output Format
```json
{
  "summary": "<2-3 sentence executive summary>",
  "key_insights": ["<insight 1>", "<insight 2>"],
  "risks": ["<risk 1>"],
  "opportunities": ["<opportunity 1>"],
  "verdict": "<POSITIVE|NEUTRAL|NEGATIVE>",
  "confidence": <0-100>
}
```

## Required Environment Variables
- `GROQ_API_KEY` — Groq inference (Llama-3.3-70b)
